task.description:
REWORK ITERATION 2: 2 PD-UI-16 tests still failing. These are test-selector issues with CodeMirror, NOT code bugs. 61/63 pass.

Fix ONLY the test file web/tests/e2e/f2-canvas-shoulds.e2e.spec.ts:

1. **TC-PDUI16-01**: `.cm-placeholder` doesn't exist in CodeMirror 6 DOM. CodeMirror renders placeholder via decorations inside the editor div. Fix: use `.cm-content` or `.cm-editor` selector instead of `.cm-placeholder`.

2. **TC-PDUI16-02**: `page.keyboard.type()` doesn't work with CodeMirror contenteditable div. Fix: use `page.locator('.cm-content').click()` then `page.keyboard.type('...')` — ensure the editor is focused first.

DO NOT change any component code. Only fix test selectors.
acceptance_criteria: npm run type-check, lint, build pass

result.summary: Fixed D - Test error in f2-canvas-shoulds.e2e.spec.ts: (1) Replaced non-existent .cm-placeholder selector with .cm-content (CodeMirror 6 renders placeholder via CSS ::before pseudo-element, not a DOM class). (2) Replaced cmInput.fill("") with keyboard select-all + backspace for CodeMirror contenteditable div where fill() is not supported.
